Class DOIService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services.DOIService
@Service public class DOIService extends Object
Recognizes a DOI (Digital Object Identifier) expressed in any of several common formats and normalizes it to its canonical bare form (ANSI/NISO Z39.84), e.g. 10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2.

Recognized formats include:

  • Actionable web URLs, e.g. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2 or the deprecated http://dx.doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2
  • shortDOI URLs, e.g. https://doi.org/c234 or https://doi.org/10/c234
  • Plain/bare DOI strings, e.g. 10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2
  • The doi: prefix, e.g. doi:10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2
  • The urn:doi: namespace, e.g. urn:doi:10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2
  • The (deprecated) info:doi/ URI scheme, e.g. info:doi/10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2

    • normalizeRawDOI

      public String normalizeRawDOI(String rawDoi)
      Normalizes a DOI given in any of the recognized formats to its canonical bare form.
      Parameters:
      rawDoi - the DOI, in any recognized format
      Returns:
      the canonical, lower-cased, bare DOI (e.g. 10.1038/s41586-020-2649-2)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if rawDoi cannot be recognized as a DOI in any of the supported formats
